intended_object: The sequence of binomial polynomials n ↦ (X choose n) = X(X−1)⋯(X−n+1)/n! in K[X], where (X choose n) has degree n, over a nontrivial ℚ-algebra K, packaged as a polynomial sequence. Inferred from the docstring and the module documentation.
explanation: The n-th term is `Ring.choose X n`. In K[X] this is the generalized binomial coefficient X(X−1)⋯(X−n+1)/n!, using the binomial-ring structure Mathlib gives to any ℚ≥0-module ring. The degree field comes from `degree_ringChoose_X`, which proves degree n by comparing n! • (X choose n) with the descending Pochhammer polynomial. `Nontrivial K` is required, since otherwise no element can have degree n. The ℚ-algebra hypothesis is essentially forced: for K[X] to contain (X choose 2) = (X² − X)/2, 2 must be a unit in K, and likewise every n!. Over ℤ, for instance, the binomial polynomials only exist in the ring of integer-valued polynomials, not in ℤ[X]. Commutativity of K is not assumed. A search of Mathlib found no packaged binomial polynomial sequence. The definition matches the intended object at its natural generality.
